name: Odd Arcade · 奇怪风
intro:
Catch a drifting letter before it bounces away. The small number tells you how many taps you have left.
追着字母敲。键帽上的小数字，是这个字符还剩的次数。

name: Monochrome · 黑白简约风
intro:
Read the counter on each moving key. Spend the last use and that character needs a reload.
看准移动键帽上的余量。用掉最后一次，这个字符就得换弹。

name: Pixel Punk · 朋克风
intro:
Track the red pixel keys across the dark grid. Three matching characters at the end unlock a whole-word delete.
盯住暗色网格上的红色像素键。草稿末尾出现三连，就能整词删除。

name: Pop Comic · 动漫风
intro:
Tap the bouncing sticker you want. Miss a letter and it may take three matching taps to erase the word.
点中弹跳的字母贴纸。拼错后，要让词尾凑出三连才能删词。

name: Chalk · 简约纯白
intro:
Tap letters or glide across them to form a word. Pick a suggestion, erase a word or undo the deletion.
点按或滑过字母成词，可选候选词，也可删词后撤销。

name: Phantom · 神秘风
intro:
Type from memory as used keys dim. Adjust their speed or reload a missing character before you aim to send.
用过的字符会变暗。记住盲打的内容，调节键速或换回字符，再瞄准发送。

name: Silver Mist · 雾灰
intro:
White keycaps move across a slate-grey field. Read the corner count and catch your next letter.
白色键帽在雾灰底板上移动。看角标余量，点中下一个字母。

name: Oat Paper · 燕麦纸
intro:
Cream keys drift across a warm paper field. Keep your word in the draft while you reload a spent letter.
奶油色键帽在燕麦纸面上漂移。某个字母用完，换弹时草稿会保留。

name: Prism Pulse · 彩虹爆闪风
intro:
Catch the keys as their neon faces flash across the grid. A spent key loses its colour until you reload it.
追着网格里轮流闪亮的霓虹键帽输入。字符耗尽会褪色，换弹后重新亮起。
